method: Footprint analysis of the code path (per item and per batch), checked against Soroban per-transaction limits. Re-measure with `stellar contract invoke --sim-only` against a 16-item batch and update `budgets/baseline.json` when the code path changes.

per_item.read_entries_notes: WorkItem key + attestation-registry AttestationSequence, RevokedThrough and the latest Attestation entry. Records with long, interleaved version history (up to MAX_HISTORY=10) read more; such batches fail at simulation and must be split.

per_batch_fixed.read_entries_notes: instance entries of incentive-pool, attester-registry and attestation-registry + EpochApproved; plus 1 attester-registry read per distinct attester (memoized in-call)

justification: 16 items keep writes at 18/50 and typical reads at 84/100 even with every item from a distinct attester; 32 items would exceed the read limit (148).
